get_property_from_atoms: get a property value from an ASE Atoms object by name using get_property_from_atoms
normalize_property_by_natoms: normalize a property value by the number of atoms using normalize_property with natoms
normalize_property_by_another_property: normalize a property value by another property using normalize_property with a property name
get_property_dict_from_atoms: get a dictionary of multiple properties from an ASE Atoms object using get_property_dict_from_atoms
get_property_dict_with_normalization: get a dictionary of properties with per-atom normalization using get_property_dict_from_atoms and normalize_by
